draft_76984122484b.subject: Exploring a WASH Strategic Partnership with Jaldhaara Foundation | Tata Chemicals Limited
draft_76984122484b.body:
Dear Head of CSR & Sustainability,

Jaldhaara Foundation has tracked Tata Chemicals Limited's notable CSR initiatives in safe water and community health. We specialize in deploying sustainable, community-owned water purification infrastructure.

In particular, we noted your impactful water initiative: "TCSRD safe drinking water projects covering 45 villages with installation of 12 community RO plants in Gujarat.".

We would welcome a brief 15-minute conversation to explore aligning our safe drinking water hubs with your CSR goals.

Could we schedule a call next week?

Partnerships Team
Jaldhaara Foundation
www.jaldhaara.org

revision_history.subject: Exploring a WASH Strategic Partnership with Jaldhaara Foundation | Tata Chemicals Limited
revision_history.body:
Dear Head of CSR & Sustainability,

On behalf of Jaldhaara Foundation, I am writing to commend Tata Chemicals Limited's ongoing commitment to sustainable community development and Corporate Social Responsibility.

We have closely followed your verified initiatives, including: "TCSRD safe drinking water projects covering 45 villages with installation of 12 community RO plants in Gujarat.".

Given your demonstrated focus on multi-year sustainable infrastructure, Jaldhaara Foundation proposes co-designing an institutional partnership to establish community water purification hubs in water-stressed rural districts, ensuring long-term operational sustainability and verifiable impact.

Could we arrange a brief 20-minute introductory conversation next Tuesday or Thursday at your convenience?

Warm regards,

Partnerships Team
Jaldhaara Foundation
www.jaldhaara.org
